Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
At Infosys, we believe the future is full of possibilities—and none of the incredible things we achieve would be possible without our exceptional people and culture. We foster an environment where ideas thrive, innovation is encouraged, and you're empowered to take your career as far as your ambition leads. 
 We are committed to ensuring your career never stands still. At Infosys, you’ll be inspired to build what’s next and grow alongside us. Our values—continuous learning, integrity, and trusted client relationships—are the foundation of everything we do, and they are upheld by our people. 
 Your Role 
 As a Network Engineer, you will play a key role in managing and supporting our network infrastructure. You will configure, support, maintain customer network and ensure successful execution to deliver high-quality outcomes. You’ll collaborate with top industry talent to develop innovative, reliable, and scalable solutions that meet our clients’ evolving needs. 
 You’ll be part of a culture that values learning, teamwork, and excellence—where diversity is respected and contributions are recognized. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Configure, support, and maintain Cisco routers and switches. 
 Manage Cisco Wireless and Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE). 
 Troubleshoot and configure Cisco routing and switching protocols 
 Plan and execute network hardware/software upgrades (Lifecycle Management). 
 Monitor network performance and resolve issues proactively. 
 Lead root cause analysis sessions and major incident reviews to resolve recurring issues. 
 Collaborate with other network engineers to troubleshoot complex performance issues. 
 Configure, support, and troubleshoot Fortinet SD-WAN on FortiGate devices, including SD-WAN members, zones, and traffic steering rules. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Hands-on experience in data centre operations and smart hands support. 
 Certifications such as CCNA or equivalent. 
 Familiarity with software-defined networking (SDN), Cisco ACI, and Software-Defined Access (SDA). 
 Hands-on experience deploying and operating Fortinet SD-WAN in multi-site enterprise environments, including IPsec VPN connectivity and integration with BGP or OSPF routing. 
 Personal Attributes 
 We value not only technical expertise but also strong personal qualities, including: 
 Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 Initiative, adaptability, and a proactive mindset. 
 Strong customer orientation and service mindset. 
 High attention to detail and quality. 
 Outstanding verbal and written communication skills. 
 About Infosys 
 Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 46 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over three decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through the many next of their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise and ideas from our innovation ecosystem. 
 Visit www.infosys.com to see how Infosys can help your enterprise navigate your next. 
 All aspects of employment at Infosys are based on merit, competence and performance. We are committed to embracing diversity and creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Infosys is proud to be an equal opportunity employer
